rationale: Cross-vertical KB coverage; same set used for every device row for fair comparison. Each query targets a category that exists in at least one of the 7 supported industry templates (telco, banking, healthcare, airline, insurance, electric-utility, water-utility) so the harness can be run against any active config without per-vertical tuning.
queries: How do I check my balance?
What are your roaming rates for Singapore?
How do I dispute a transaction?
What is covered by my plan?
How do I cancel my appointment?
How do I report an outage?
What payment methods do you accept?
I need help troubleshooting my connection
